description: Dialog furniture is drawn and aligned by the styled primitives: the title sits on a blue nameplate across the sheet's top edge, and the DialogActions dock at the foot puts the way out on the left and the actions on the right. A dialog has one way out, a button of its own. Applies when building or changing any dialog in src/components.
